mechanics.claim: Kalista can dash by inputting a move command during her basic attack windup or during Pierce's cast time.
mechanics.quote: When '''Kalista''' inputs a {{tt|movement command|Default MB2/right click}} during her {{tip|attack windup|basic attack windup}} or shortly after it completes, or while in cast time of ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'', she will {{tip|dash}} in that direction.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks and Pierce cannot be cast while Kalista is dashing.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks and ''{{ai|Pierce|Kalista}}'' cannot be cast while dashing, unless animation cancelled with a movement command.

mechanics.claim: Kalista will automatically re-attack her remembered target at the end of a dash if they remain in range.
mechanics.quote: '''Kalista''' will automatically be issued an attack command on her attack target at the end of the dash, as long as they remain in her attack range by then.

mechanics.claim: Martial Poise cannot keep up with attack speeds greater than 2.1, limiting effective attack cadence.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Martial Poise|Kalista}} cannot keep up with attack speed values greater than {{fd|2.1}}, due to the combination of her auto attack windup taking too long, and her dashes being too slow.

mechanics.claim: Kalista cannot dash while immobilized or grounded, and is knocked down by immobilizing/polymorph CC during the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Kalista''' {{tt|cannot dash|See notes}} while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}, and she will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.
